title: ever ÉMILE|Off the Shoulder Ruffle Bodice Long Flowy Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This romantic long flowy bridesmaid dress features a flowy off-shoulder neckline and floor-length skirt with a thigh-high slit. We think it's perfect to wear this off the shoulder bridesmaid dress at any wedding, evening, party, cocktail, prom, homecoming, graduation or as a holiday vacation dress.

Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.


Closure: No Zipper.


Undergarments: It is Not Padded, with Lining.


Fabric: Shell:100%Polyester
Lining:100%Polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is No Stretch.
